Biology 2017-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2017-I.question: Polynucleotide chain of DNA contains
options: a nitrogenous base, deoxyribose sugar and phosphate group
a nitrogenous base, ribose sugar and phosphate group
deoxyribose sugar, ribose sugar and phosphate group
a nitrogenous base and phosphate group only
Biology 2017-I.answer: a nitrogenous base, deoxyribose sugar and phosphate group
Biology 2017-I.explanation: (a) DNA is made up of many nucleotides joining together, called polynucleotide chain of DNA. Each polynucleotide is made up of three components: (i) nitrogenous base [such as adenine (A), guanine (G), cytocine (C) and thymine (T)], (ii) deoxyribose sugar, and (iii) phosphate group.

Biology 2017-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2017-I.question: The process of copying genetic information from one strand of DNA into RNA is termed as
Biology 2017-I.explanation: (b)  The process by which the genetic information in a strand of DNA is copied into a new molecule of messenger RNA (mRNA) is termed as transcription. It is carried out by an enzyme called RNA polymerase and a number of accessory proteins called transcription factors.

Biology 2017-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2017-I.question: In human body, the cell growth and differentiation are highly controlled and regulated, but in cancer cells
options: there is breakdown of these regulatory mechanisms leading to formation of benign and malignant tumors
controlled cell division and over- production of genetic material occur
RNA is mutated and produced in less amount
DNA is mutated and produced in less amount
Biology 2017-I.answer: there is breakdown of these regulatory mechanisms leading to formation of benign and malignant tumors
Biology 2017-I.explanation: (a)  In cancer, there is unwanted cell proliferation leading to uncontrolled cell division. Some cancers may spread into other tissues. Mutation is the main cause of cancer at genetic level. Mutation causing agents are called carcinogens, such as UV radiation, tobacco and tobacco smoke, pesticides, etc.

Biology 2017-I.explanation: (b)  In general, plant viruses have single-stranded RNA. Animal viruses have either single or double-stranded RNA or double-stranded DNA. Bacterial viruses usually have double stranded DNA.

Biology 2017-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2017-I.question: Bleeding of gums, falling of teeth, fragile bones and delayed wound healing occur due to the deficiency of which one of the following vitamins?
Biology 2017-I.explanation: (a)  Vitamin C is needed to produce skin, tendons, ligaments, and blood vessel. It is also needed in repair of bones and teeth. Deficiency of vitamin C results in bleeding of gums, falling of teeth, weak bones and delay in wound healing.

Biology 2017-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2017-I.question: The mammalian heart is myogenic and it is regulated by nerves. The heartbeat originates from
Biology 2017-I.explanation: (a)  Heart beat originates from sinoatrial node, a group of cells situated in the upper part of the right atrium wall. The electrical impulses causing the heart beat are generated in sinoatrial node. Hepatic portal system comprises hepatic portal vein and veinlets. T wave depicts repolarization of heart ventricles. QRS wave are three waves seen on a electrocardiogram.

Biology 2017-I.subject: Biology
Biology 2017-I.question: The plant growth regulators are small, simple molecules of diverse chemical composition. They are
options: indole compounds, adenine derivatives, carotenoids and terpenes
vitamin C, vitamin D and glucose
Biology 2017-I.answer: indole compounds, adenine derivatives, carotenoids and terpenes
Biology 2017-I.explanation: (b)  Plant growth regulators or plant hormones (phytohormones) are chemicals that control plant growth, e.g. auxins, gibberellins, cytokinins, abscisic acid and ethylene. Auxin is composed of indole-3-acetic acid. Cytokinins are derivatives of the nitrogenous purine base adenine. Some plant hormones are also composed of derivatives of carotenoids and terpenes.
